name: Grilled Balsamic Halloumi with Pepper Relish & Creamy Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat halloumi dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the halloumi in half horizontally, then cut each half crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the marinade, then gently turn to coat. Set aside to marinate, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 jalapeño peppers
2 red bell peppers
1 lemon
2 English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Place in another medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim, seed, and quarter bell peppers lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the jalapeño along with oil, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add peppers and grill until charred, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate to cool slightly. (Reserve pan for later use and bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, and spices, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp dill, dried
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
Return the pan to medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add the halloumi and cook, turning halfway through, until charred on both sides, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Small dice cooled peppers. Add to the bowl with the parsley, along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the pepper relish.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp balsamic vinegar
1 tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cucumber salad and halloumi between plates or bowls. Top halloumi with pepper relish and enjoy!
